records.source_context_population_selection: Unrelated western-European adults selected for GWAS, preferring the oldest family members. Exclusions: diabetes by self-report or FPG >=7.0 mmol/L; anemia at the reported sex-specific thresholds; missing HbA1c, erythrocytes or FPG. Source context: CTX_JANSEN_SELECTED.
records.measurement_mapping: Native BMI/FPG units; model HbA1c percent converted back to IFCC covariance by dividing by 0.09148. No assay equivalence claim.
records.source_uncertainty_treatment: No estimator SE or confirmed-level CI is supplied. Printed Jansen intervals remain descriptive. No CI-to-SD, equivalence test, precision weights or pooled source loss.
records.cross_source_overlap: Jansen's two coefficients and its margins share Lifelines and are not independent confirmations. Bao's correlation and its margins share SHDS II; MIND rank and margins share MIND-China. The packet gives distinct cohort names but no cross-study participant linkage audit. NGSP and converted source values are deterministic representations, not added evidence.
records.identifies: One separate age/sex-adjusted source projection; jointly with the other projection and assumed residual covariance it defines a chosen joint linear response.
records.construction_assumes: Jansen's separate age/sex-adjusted slopes constrain two residualized population projections. Their conversion uses the NGSP slope multiplier. A stipulated nonzero BMI/FPG residual covariance identifies one member of an otherwise unidentified family of joint HbA1c coefficients; the two printed slopes are never pasted into a joint equation.
records.moment_derivation_or_receipt: mathematical_properties.md and analytic_source_checks.py; exact affine loading-matrix moments of the actual model family, with context-specific parameters
records.calculated_value_or_unavailable_reason: See bound analytic_results.json. Calculation is a qualified source population functional, not replay.
records.reason: Use as separately adjusted projection constraint, retaining the assumed residual cross-covariance and transport limitations.

records.source_context_population_selection: Six Shanghai communities, 2007-2008; excludes previously diagnosed diabetes and specified medical, questionnaire and age exclusions, retaining screen-detected diabetes. Explicit exclusion under age 20 differs from prose over age 20; exact boundary unresolved. Source context: CTX_BAO_ANALYZED.
records.measurement_mapping: Fasting venous plasma FPG and HPLC HbA1c percent in the separately selected Bao scenario; no mapping to target serum is certified.
records.source_uncertainty_treatment: No estimator SE or confirmed-level CI is supplied. Printed Jansen intervals remain descriptive. No CI-to-SD, equivalence test, precision weights or pooled source loss.

Bao's correlation and its margins share SHDS II; MIND rank and margins share MIND-China. The packet gives distinct cohort names but no cross-study participant linkage audit. NGSP and converted source values are deterministic representations, not added evidence.
records.identifies: One unadjusted source Pearson functional, not conditional slopes, tails or target correlation.
records.construction_assumes: A distinct Bao post-exclusion source scenario has a piecewise-linear quantile age law with probability knots 0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1 and age knots 20.1,37.9,49.4,57.7,85; endpoint ages are assumptions. Reported female count fraction is used. Ordinary BMI and FPG symmetric-uniform scales use their IQR/sqrt(3); the BMI center 23.5 need not match asymmetric quartiles exactly. All stated health exclusions are conditioned upon without reconstructing their selection mechanism. The upper component represents screen-detected hyperglycemia only as a hypothetical scenario.

records.reason: Check the transported affine-plus-excess law in a separate Bao selection scenario. Retain raw discrepancy without optimizing it.

records.source_context_population_selection: Selected 2019 rural Yanlou/Shandong follow-up, age 61-80, free of dementia and functional disability; known diabetes included. Demographics/BMI collected in 2018, laboratory measurements in 2019. Source context: CTX_MIND_ANALYZED.
records.measurement_mapping: MIND FSG serum and EDTA HPLC HbA1c percent retained; do not alias the separately measured FPG.
records.source_uncertainty_treatment: No estimator SE or confirmed-level CI is supplied. Printed Jansen intervals remain descriptive. No CI-to-SD, equivalence test, precision weights or pooled source loss.

records.identifies: One source rank correlation, not ordinary covariance, conditional age effect or target rank distribution.
records.construction_assumes: MIND's reported serum-glucose Spearman correlation is contextual only. Its older selected/imputed cohort and rank distribution are not represented by a declared source law here. Ordinary moments cannot identify Spearman; do not substitute Pearson or a Gaussian-copula formula. MIND FSG is distinct from its separately measured FPG.
records.calculated_value_or_unavailable_reason: No independently reviewed source rank-law derivation; source imputation and ties are not identified by the packet.
records.reason: Different older selected/imputed source population and unrepresented rank law; no legitimate moment-only Spearman evaluation is available.
